title: Shopinbos vs Shopify
h1: Shopinbos vs Shopify for Nigerian sellers
sub: Shopify is a great global platform. Shopinbos is built for selling in Nigeria: naira, pay on delivery, riders, and selling on WhatsApp, Instagram and TikTok from one app. Here’s an honest look at which fits you.
us: Your customers want pay on delivery
You sell in your store and on WhatsApp, Instagram and TikTok
You want to pay in naira
them: You need a very large app store
You have a developer or agency
rows: Price | Free plan, then from ₦7,500 a month | Paid plans after a free trial, billed in US dollars | us
Payments in Nigeria | Cards, transfer and USSD built in, through Paystack | Through a payment app such as Paystack | us
Pay on delivery | Built in, with rider codes and same-day cash | Manual cash on delivery option | us
Local riders at checkout | Built in for Lagos, Abuja, Ibadan, Port Harcourt | Through third-party apps | us
Selling on WhatsApp, Instagram and TikTok | Built in, one list of products and one inbox | Through apps | us
AI help | Rex and Peggy, in English and Pidgin | AI tools available | us
Themes and apps | Growing library of templates | Thousands of themes and apps | them
Selling worldwide | Nigeria first, export for brands | Strong, in many countries | them
Support | WhatsApp, English and Pidgin, 8am to 8pm | 24/7 chat and email | tie
steps: Export your products from Shopify as a CSV
Upload the file in Shopinbos, Rex maps the fields
Turn on pay on delivery and riders
faq: Is Shopify available in Nigeria? | Yes. You can use Shopify from Nigeria. Check how you will take payments in naira and arrange delivery before you choose.

title: Shopinbos vs WooCommerce
h1: Shopinbos vs WooCommerce for Nigerian sellers
sub: WooCommerce is powerful and flexible if you have a developer. Shopinbos does the setup, hosting and updates for you. Here’s how they compare.
us: You don’t want to manage a website
You run the shop from your phone
You want riders and pay on delivery ready
You want help in plain words
them: You need full control of the code
You have a developer on hand
You need a very custom checkout
rows: Price | Free plan, then from ₦7,500 a month | Free plugin, plus hosting, domain and paid extensions | us
Setup | Tell Rex what you sell, ready in minutes | Install WordPress, a theme and plugins | us
Payments in Nigeria | Built in, through Paystack | Paystack and Flutterwave plugins available | tie
Pay on delivery | With rider codes and same-day cash | Cash on delivery option built in | us
Delivery | Riders booked at checkout | Through plugins | us
Updates and security | Done for you | You or your developer | us
Customisation | Templates and settings | Almost unlimited, it’s open source | them
Run from your phone | Built for phone first | WooCommerce mobile app available | tie
steps: Export products from WooCommerce as a CSV
Upload it in Shopinbos, Rex maps the fields
faq: Is WooCommerce available in Nigeria? | Yes. You can use WooCommerce from Nigeria. Check how you will take payments in naira and arrange delivery before you choose.
